summary: Authenticates against AFFiNE >= 0.27 with a JWT session (sign-in, exchange, refresh) instead of a personal access token, and fails loudly when the server treats the CLI as anonymous.
reason: The server only honours a Bearer that is a JWT (core/auth/guard.ts isLikelyJwt) and silently downgrades any other Bearer, including the retired ut_ tokens, to an anonymous request. doctor passed on HTTP 404 and canvas reads died with "missing 'data' field". Decision: cache the rotating refresh token in session.json (0600, next to config.toml) and refresh it, with a lock across processes, rather than signing in on every run; this opens one device session and still re-logs in with AFFINE_EMAIL/AFFINE_PASSWORD when the refresh token is gone. Credentials come from the environment only. Not applied to the server: Copilot/MCP credentials stay a founder decision.
validated_outcome: go test of authsession, config, cli, socketio, canvaswrite and client against an httptest fake of the session endpoints; doctor classifies currentUser null as invalid and exits non-zero. Live validation depends on the agent credential in OpenBao /agents/showrunner/affine.
